main_text.p: feriam fextam. Eodem anno Chrifti 1582 incidit ThothNabonafari 2331, feria tertia, quæ incurrit in 24 diem Iulii: atqui à 24 Iulii inclufiuè vfque ad primas idus Gregorianas exclufiuè numerantur 73 dies, qui efficiunt duos menfes Ægyptios, & 13 dies. itaque dies decima quarta menfis Athyr, anni Nabonafari 2331, refpondet primis idibus Gregorianis. Sed interuallum inter idus Gregorianas, & vltimam Decembris, à cuius meridie moreaftronomico[?] incipit annus Chrifti 1583, eft 87 dierum.
Primus cyclus triacontaëtericus Arabum in principiis fingulorum annorum hos habet characteres feriarum: vt perspicere licet ex sequenti tabella.

Annus primus cùm fimplex fit, conftat 354 die-bus: qui fi per feptem diuidantur, in refiduo relin-quunt quatuor: hæc ad fex characterem radicis adie-cta producunt decem: à quibus fi fubtrahantur fep-tem, remanet ternarius, qui character eft anni fe-cundi, incipientis feria tertia. Annus autem fecun-dus cùm bifextilis fit, conftat 355 diebus: qui efficiunt

page.notes: The "5" in "1582" and "1583" and in the table is printed in a long-s-like form; read as 5. The mark "moreaftronomico" appears printed without a space; marked [?]. The table's left-hand "b" signs are single letters read as b. Catchword "so le-" is at the foot right; the page ends mid-word, so the text ends with the last full line.
